open_points.subject: store spool-byte read capability used by run execution and service request building
open_points.text: `capability:store` candidate public capabilities: `put_value_bytes`, `read_value_bytes`, `spool_file`, `remove_run_spool` ... and in State 4: `file inputs are read through capability:store.read_value_bytes`
open_points.question: Does `store.read_value_bytes` read bytes from the run spool as well as content-addressed value storage, or is a separate spool-read capability required?
options: `read_value_bytes` is defined to read both value-area bytes and spool bytes
Add a separate capability (for example `read_spool_file`) and use it wherever run-spooled files are consumed
Copy every spooled file into value storage before any downstream read and always use `read_value_bytes`
open_points.default_guess: Add a separate spool-read capability and switch run/effect file-input reads to it.

open_points.subject: capture flow refusal after spool files are copied
open_points.text: State 4 capture step: `It copies the spooled input files into the content-addressed area ... and calls capability:functions.add_captured_trial_case ... module:functions checks ...` while errors include function-side refusals
open_points.question: If `add_captured_trial_case` refuses after file bytes were copied, what is the required outcome for those copied bytes?
options: Keep copied bytes (unreferenced bytes may remain)
Roll back/remove copied bytes when capture is refused
Reorder flow so all refusals happen before any file-copy write
open_points.default_guess: Keep copied bytes, since writes are content-addressed and immutable.

open_points.subject: node status on target-port validation failure during run propagation
open_points.text: A13 rule 3: `a violation concludes the producing node, or the receiving node, contract_violation, and the value is not delivered.`
open_points.question: When source output validates but target-port validation fails, which node must receive `contract_violation` in trace and run progression?
options: Depends on which check failed first, with an explicit deterministic rule
open_points.default_guess: Fail the receiving node, because the violation occurs at input acceptance.
